summary: Chicago Atlantic BDC, Inc. (LIEN) filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026, announcing it entered into a merger agreement to acquire Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance, Inc. (REFI). REFI will merge into LIEN, with LIEN surviving. No price-per-share, premium, or deal value was disclosed. The LIEN Board, on a special committee recommendation, unanimously approved the merger as fair to stockholders. Pre-merger, REFI will elect BDC status under the Investment Company Act, and management agreements will terminate without payment. The parties intend the merger to be a tax-free reorganization. Key watchpoints include stockholder votes and regulatory approvals; risk-arb focuses on structure and timing.
